Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Assisting a Friend Moving Near Your University
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend, Daniel, who is preparing to move into a rented apartment near your university. Read part of his email below:

"I am moving to a new apartment near your university next weekend! Since you are familiar with the area, could you recommend a reliable moving company or delivery service to help me transport my belongings? Would you be available to give me a hand on the moving day? Also, could you tell me a little bit about what the neighborhood and neighbors are like there? Thanks so much!"

Write an email responding to Daniel.

Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Religious tourism, also known as spiritual tourism, where people travel to sacred sites, temples, pagodas, and pilgrimage destinations, has grown rapidly in many parts of the world."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of religious tourism for individuals and local communities. Include specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your view.
